in_marathi.name: Jayaasri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayaasri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayaasri is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'jaya' meaning victory and 'asri' meaning prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Jayaasri is considered the goddess of victory, success, and good fortune. She is also known as the consort of Lord Ayyappan and is revered in various parts of India.
